The identified controlling passage is Chapter 5 §5.4 Parameter transmission modes and figure 5.1. The 1986 SIMULA Standard documents value, reference, and name transmission for procedures. Value-type parameters default to value transmission and other kinds default to reference transmission. Allowed explicit modes depend on the parameter kind. Class declarations are a separate scope. Figure 5.1 explicitly marks some modes illegal for particular kinds. The claim states the defaults and does not imply each mode applies universally.
